$comment: FORM P4-T4 retroactive admission record (the slot predates the budget, so it is also in baselineSlots; this record documents why it earned its place). Probe strengthened, apps and teaching line checked against the files on 2026-11-17. The slot is the `set` PROPERTY of an updateConcept step, not the step type `set`.

declarative.why: lists which fields an updateConcept step writes and with what (a literal or a $ref); no ordering, no logic

notLower.why: a persisted field write goes through the platform's checks (access, invariants, lifecycle, audit); an expression only computes a value, it cannot write a row

taught.bundleLine: An updateConcept may write chosen fields instead of $input: {"type":"updateConcept","scope":"Ticket","id":"$input.id","set":{"status":"CLOSED","note":"$input.note"},"createIfMissing":true,"output":"$row"}
